description: A Rust app using the winapp CLI can show toasts through `winapp run --with-alias` but not after `create-debug-identity`, based on https://github.com/microsoft/winappCli/issues/352.
prompt: I'm showing a toast from a Rust app with the winapp CLI. `winapp create-debug-identity .\target\debug\tide-alert.exe` then running the exe gives `Error showing notification: The notification platform is unavailable. (0x803E0105)`, but `winapp run .\target\debug --with-alias` works. Running as admin also happens to work, but I don't want that as the requirement.
